document.abstract: With the advent of automation in TV stations, it has become apparent that methods must be developed to cue the film automatically at the start of each film sequence. This paper describes methods for automatically stopping a projector with a predetermined frame in the gate by adding suitable cuing information to the film and associated reading and control mechanisms to the projector.
